bearer.description: A Kubernetes ServiceAccount token whose audience is display-api.

mutualTLS.description: A client certificate the cluster's own authority signed. The subject's common name is the user and its organization values are the groups, which is how the API server reads one.

info.description: The path names the Display, the extension or Accept chooses the format, and a region and a time span are W3C Media Fragments 1.0 in the query. Nothing is stored. The manual is at https://display.liken.sh/docs/reference/api/.
info.summary: The screen of every Display in this cluster, as one frame, a clip, or a stream.

parameters.name: width

parameters.description: Scale the region down to this height, keeping the aspect. Given together with width it is refused.

parameters.description: Frames per second of a clip or a stream, 15 by default, at most the output's refresh.

parameters.description: JPEG quality from 1 to 100, 85 by default.
